rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0001
rows.name:
I just remembered an old story
my grandma told me once.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0002
rows.name:
It was about a man called Ephem,
known as the First Emperor.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Ephem journeyed across the lands to
build his fame, and along the way met
someone named Cretas.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0004
rows.name:
The stories don't say whether Cretas
was a Divine Beast, an engineer, a
Blade, or a Driver.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Ephem traveled with Cretas, reached
this Divine Beast, and laid the
foundations of Superbia...

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Then his son inherited the conquest,
annexed the neighboring nations, and
apparently took the title of Emperor.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0007
rows.name:
...Superbia has the longest history
of any nation in this area.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0008
rows.name:
So it's only natural that this Divine
Beast is nearing the end of its life.

rows.label: tlk45420151_04_msg0009
rows.name:
Still, the Superbian Divine
Beast is under a heavy load
now, and that worries me...
